The '''Pernicious Parrot''' is a monster that is located in the [[Jade vine maze]]. It is encountered during [[Back to my Roots]], along with [[Tenacious toucan|Tenacious Toucan]]. Both of these monsters count towards 'Bird' slayer assignments.
